inventoryMethod.traversal: Recursive depth-first walk of EVERY object at every depth in both source ledgers, including objects below PASS parents. One inventory record per object holding a string status not exactly PASS; RFC 6901 pointers address that object. No collection/depth whitelist.
inventoryMethod.nonstandardPolicy: All other string status values are retained in nonPassInventory and also listed separately in nonstandardStatusInventory; no non-PASS string status is dropped.
inventoryMethod.enclosingRecord: Nearest proper ancestor with a string case or id, otherwise the object itself if identified; null if none. relation distinguishes self from ancestor.
inventoryMethod.kindPolicy: Parent case and subcase at final collections; top-level history, authoritative history, nested history, supplemental, nested observation, otherwise nested status.
inventoryMethod.evidencePolicy: Evidence paths on the status object, falling back to its enclosing identified record; path references only. Historical overlap is not a count of distinct current defects.
